provenance: Synthetic English smoke examples authored for software checking; no scientific reference labels.

documents.title: Solid electrolytes for rechargeable batteries
documents.abstract: This study investigates ceramic electrolytes in rechargeable lithium cells. Ionic transport and contact resistance are measured during repeated charging and discharging.

documents.title: Seasonal migration of coastal birds
documents.abstract: Researchers track coastal birds over several seasons using satellite tags. Their analysis describes nesting locations, migration distances and changes in feeding behaviour.

documents.title: Digital files encoded into synthetic DNA
documents.abstract: Digital images are encoded in synthetic DNA sequences and recovered by sequencing. The proposed error correcting code protects stored information against substitutions and deletions.

documents.title: Mineral composition of volcanic rocks
documents.abstract: Geological samples from volcanic islands are examined under a microscope. Mineral composition and crystal structure reveal the cooling history of ancient lava flows.

documents.title: Learning temporal signals with a quantum reservoir
documents.abstract: A quantum reservoir uses the dynamics of interacting qubits to process temporal inputs. A trained linear readout estimates the next value of a benchmark sequence.

documents.title: Irrigation schedules for wheat production
documents.abstract: Field trials compare irrigation schedules during wheat cultivation. Soil moisture, rainfall and grain yield are recorded to estimate water requirements across several farms.

documents.title: Stable perovskite absorbers for photovoltaic devices
documents.abstract: Perovskite thin films absorb sunlight in photovoltaic devices. This study measures charge extraction and power conversion efficiency after exposure to heat and moisture.

documents.title: Trade routes in medieval coastal towns
documents.abstract: Historical archives describe merchants and shipping routes between medieval towns. Records of household goods and harbour fees are compared across several centuries.

documents.title: Photonic neural networks for optical matrix computation
documents.abstract: An integrated photonic neural network performs weighted matrix multiplication with optical signals. Measurements demonstrate the computing operation in a programmable optical circuit.

documents.title: Ecological surveys of tropical coral reefs
documents.abstract: Marine biologists survey coral reefs to record fish populations and coral diversity. Their observations describe ecological changes after seasonal storms in tropical waters.

documents.title: Photonic interconnects for neural network accelerators
documents.abstract: An optical interconnect transfers activations between electronic processors in a neural network accelerator. All matrix multiplication and nonlinear activation are performed electronically; the photonic link transports the data but does not execute neural computation.

documents.title: Optical switches with a possible future neural application
documents.abstract: The experiment characterizes an optical switch for communication systems. The authors suggest that future photonic neural networks could use this device, but no neural computation or synaptic operation is demonstrated in the present study.
